messages:
deploy-bot: Starting phased rollout to production for tag v1.8.2 (commit abcdef12). Environments: prod. Regions: us, eu, apac. Change window: 03:00-05:00 UTC. Canary config: 10% traffic per region, 15 minute canary. Release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/v1.8.2

alexc: Thanks. Any DB/schema changes or config flags to be aware of?

deploy-bot: No DB migrations. Primary changes: runtime kernel selection tweak + routing weight adjustments. No config flags.

priya: I'll watch the latency and error dashboards for EU during canary. rachel-oncall, you up for coverage? :eyes:

rachel-oncall: On it, monitoring dashboards and alerting.

deploy-bot: us rollout started — us-west-2 canary (10%) at ts 1751234580.

jamie: seeing a small p95 bump in us canary, from ~80ms -> ~120ms, spike lasted ~2m. Not out of SLO but worth watching.

deploy-bot: us rollout finished — all us regions done, completion ts 1751234675. No errors > threshold.

deploy-bot: eu rollout started — eu-west-1 canary (10%) at ts 1751234722.

deploy-bot: ALERT (eu-west-1) — metric threshold breached: p95 latency +45% vs baseline and error rate 1.8% (threshold 1.0%). Canary paused automatically.

priya: Pausing eu rollout. I'm going to pin EU back to v1.8.1. Can someone prepare rollback command?

alexc: Confirming this looks tied to routing weight change in the new kernel, likely causing slightly different scheduling on our EU GPU pool. Agree with pausing.

rachel-oncall: Initiating rollback to v1.8.1 for EU now. Command: 
```
redwood deploy rollback --env prod --region eu --to v1.8.1 --reason "canary latency spike"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback command received. Rollback initiated for region eu (eu-west-1) at ts 1751234850. Rolling back runtime and routing config.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for eu-west-1 — region now on v1.8.1. Health checks passing, error rate back under threshold. Completion ts 1751234910.

jamie: Verified metrics: p95 returned to baseline within ~3m of rollback. No ongoing alerts.

priya: Good catch. Let's hold APAC rollout until we have a patch or more data. I'll open a follow-up issue to track root cause (routing vs kernel heuristics).

deploy-bot: APAC rollout postponed per request from priya. No apac canary started.

alexc: Can we pin EU to v1.8.1 explicitly so future automated rollouts don't re-apply v1.8.2 there?

priya: Yes — pinning EU to v1.8.1 for prod until fix is validated. Action: add region pin in deployment config (internal ticket #RD-5421).

rachel-oncall: Noted, updating incident channel and oncall playbook entries.

jamie: I'll schedule a quick postmortem sync (15m) to review routing weight change and decide on fix branch/redeploy.

alexc: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by automation. If you need to re-run rollout, use `redwood deploy start --tag v1.8.2 --regions eu,apac --env prod` after approval.
